php-phases.json.method: two reversed fresh-process rounds; php -n with ctype and mbstring; no JIT or opcache

php-memory.json.method: one fresh-process sample per depth and phase after five warmups; php -n with ctype and mbstring; no JIT or opcache

output-hashes.json.method: SHA-256 of input and output for each fixed and mixed input

wall.json.method: two ABBA rounds; PHP JIT enabled; mode not retained in raw sample

cpu.json.method: four ABBA rounds for JavaScript and Rust; process CPU time

rust-alloc.json.method: one release-build allocation probe per depth and phase

js-perf-tests.txt.method: CARVE_PERF=1 vitest run --no-file-parallelism over focused performance files

php-scaling-tests.txt.method: php -n with required extensions; vendor/bin/phpunit --group scaling

harness: The one-off runner scripts remained local; the raw samples and fixture bases are archived here.
